chars.GROOM: a Moroccan man around 30 with short black hair and a trimmed beard, wearing a mustard-yellow knit polo shirt and dark navy chinos
chars.BRIDE: a Moroccan woman around 27 with long wavy dark-brown hair loose, wearing a bright red long-sleeve satin blouse and a white wide-leg trousers, small gold hoop earrings

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Cafe terrace in Casablanca, seen from the next table. Head-to-waist framing. BRIDE, face clearly visible, firmly shakes her head and wags her index finger 'no' with a stubborn half-smile, mid-gesture; GROOM across the small table, arms spread wide as if describing something huge, surprised. Two coffee cups on the table. No text.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Daydream: GROOM in a huge glittering Moroccan wedding hall packed with hundreds of guests, gold chairs, a traditional amaria wedding chair, musicians, he smiles proudly with open arms in the middle. Warm golden light. No text.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: Cafe terrace, close medium shot of BRIDE raising her open palm toward the viewer in a firm 'stop, no no no' gesture, eyebrows raised, determined but calm expression, face visible. Blurred street behind. No text.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: Cafe terrace: BRIDE leans in and explains softly with both hands making a small circle shape, persuading; GROOM listens with a doubtful frown, chin on his hand. Afternoon light. No text.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: GROOM walking alone on a Casablanca sidewalk at dusk, looking back over his shoulder with a puzzled, suspicious expression, one eyebrow raised, hand on his neck. Calm street background. No text.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: Rushed wedding preparations in a small apartment living room: GROOM carrying boxes and a bouquet, BRIDE hurriedly trying on a white caftan in front of a mirror, a wall calendar with days crossed out in red, busy energetic mood. No text.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: GROOM sitting alone at night on the edge of a sofa in a dim living room, head down, hand on his forehead, regretful, a framed small wedding photo on the side table. Moody blue light. No text.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: Small intimate wedding party in a family living room with only a few relatives, BRIDE now in a white and gold Moroccan caftan and GROOM in a cream jabador, both laughing happily, people clapping, candles and flowers. No text.

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: Morning in the couple's new Casablanca apartment kitchen: BRIDE smiling while pouring mint tea, GROOM sitting at the table smiling back but glancing aside with a faint doubtful look, something feels off. Soft daylight. No text.
